exposure: Women with normal OGTT were analyzed.
Fasting plasma glucose (FPG) levels in early pregnancy
Intermediate hyperglycemia (fasting plasma glucose [FPG] 5.1-6.9 mM) in early pregnancy
cohort: 24,479 singleton pregnancies with FPG less than or equal to 6.9 mM in early pregnancy, including 23,450 with normal OGTTs later in pregnancy
finding: Women with intermediate hyperglycemia in early pregnancy are at an increased risk for adverse maternal-fetal outcomes, even with normal future OGTTs.
